title: S03T05 - Prove two-clone, multi-writer, worktree, and scale behavior
description: Build deterministic fixtures and benchmarks for simultaneous creates, conflicting edits, deletions, worktrees, offline rejoin, and medium/large project registries.
acceptanceCriteria: Two-clone fixtures prove no record loss across concurrent create, update, delete, conflict, pull, push, and recovery paths.
Benchmarks publish p50/p95 timings and content-hash parity for ready queues, claims, synchronization, search, and repair at agreed medium and large scales.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
